features.summary: Personal IM settings group connection cards for display while retaining per-connection binding and unbinding semantics.
boundaries: A binding does not span separate connections or bots.

features.summary: Administrators can explicitly associate active Agent IM connections with an administrator-attested instance. Account cards use that relationship before falling back to URL-only visual grouping.
boundaries: An admin attestation is a control-plane trust decision, not a Mattermost protocol fingerprint.
The association does not change D6 routing, slash-command routing, or approval identity resolution.

features.summary: D6 can send through another Bot only when both active connections share an administrator-attested instance and the recipient currently has destination-route access. Cross-Bot Mattermost delivery opens a destination-Bot DM.
boundaries: Same-connection delivery retains the existing ChatID.
Cross-Bot delivery clears the source ChatID and relies on the Mattermost driver's direct-channel creation.
Unassociated connections and recipients without current target-route access fail closed.

features.summary: Scope Mattermost bind-conflict and approval/callback identity resolution to the IM instance, not only the provider.
doneWhen: Mattermost bind-conflict checks no longer use a provider-global external identity as their security key.
Interactive-card callbacks resolve a user through the source binding or administrator-attested instance, never an arbitrary same-provider identity.
Existing non-Mattermost provider behavior and unassociated Mattermost connections remain compatible and fail closed.
